metaTitle: Custom Cotton Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton lanyards and badges for your team or event. Soft, durable, and comfortable for all-day wear at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton lanyards offer a softer, more comfortable feel compared to synthetic alternatives, making them ideal for all-day wear at trade shows, conferences, or daily office use. The natural fiber also provides a more professional, understated look that complements uniforms and branded apparel. Available in various widths from 3/8" to 1", these custom cotton lanyards can be screen printed or debossed with your logo, and many styles include badge reels or breakaway attachments for added convenience and safety.
heroAltText: Custom cotton lanyards and badges with printed logos and metal attachments for ID cards
